title: reportDamageOnReturn
description: Subscribed to `ToolReturned` on the outbox by `subscribePolicies`, and handed each one by the relay after the return commits. When the condition is `needs_repair` it invokes `reportDamage` (TL-LEND-CMD03-H), in that handler's own transaction, with the return note as the damage note, or "Returned needing repair." when there is none; when the tool already needs repair, Report damage refuses it as `tool_already_damaged` and the handler is done. If it fails otherwise, the failure is logged, the return stands and the event stays in the outbox for the next relay run, where a tool already taken out of lending changes nothing.

title: remindLoansDueTomorrow
description: Hears Loan opened through the loan it opened, which keeps its due date, and acts on the day before that date: the entry point's daily clock (TL-LEND-ENTRY01) runs it at start and every 24 hours. It reads, through `LoanRepository.notRemindedDueBetween`, the active loans due today or tomorrow in the library's time zone whose member has not been reminded; for each it invokes `remindMember` (TL-LEND-CMD08-H) in that handler's own transaction, then reads the member and the tool and hands the reminder (the member's email, a subject with the tool and the due date, and a short text) to the `ReminderSender` it is given. A loan returned or reminded in between is refused by the Loan aggregate and skipped. A send that fails is logged and not tried again, so each member is reminded at most once per loan; the example's server sends to the log, and the tests to a stand-in that records each reminder.
